site_snapshot.basis: no governed Iceland place-of-worship snapshot is included in this membership release
site_snapshot.notes: The Iceland lane ships administrative membership metrics only.

source_datasets.name: Populations by religious and life stance organizations 1998-2026
source_datasets.citation: Statistics Iceland, PX-Web MAN10001, Populations by religious and life stance organizations 1998-2026; updated 12 March 2026.
source_datasets.redistribution_limits: Statistics Iceland permits reuse under CC BY 4.0 with attribution and asks that altered data not be attributed to the institution as the source of the changes. Raw API responses remain in the git-ignored cache.
source_datasets.notes: Population 1 January. Membership in recognised organisations is registered in the National Register of Persons. Persons in unrecognised organisations or with unknown status are classified as Other and not specified.

source_datasets.name: geoBoundaries gbOpen Iceland ADM0
source_datasets.citation: geoBoundaries gbOpen ISL ADM0, release commit 9469f09, boundary year 2020; source Lýsigagnagátt.
source_datasets.redistribution_limits: The simplified derivative is redistributed under CC BY 4.0 with attribution.
source_datasets.notes: One national polygon simplified with scripts/lib/simplify_boundary.R.

indicators.label: Total
indicators.description: Statistics Iceland MAN10001 national population total on 1 January.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Iceland national total on a single geoBoundaries ADM0 polygon.
indicators.quality_notes: Population method revised in March 2024; Statistics Iceland updated 2011 onwards.

indicators.label: Membership in published religious and life-stance organisations (count)
indicators.description: Legacy area-summary field used for the sum of Statistics Iceland's 61 published named organisation rows. This is administrative register membership.
indicators.method: Sum all named organisation rows; exclude Total, Other and not specified, and No religious organisation. Published zero cells remain zero; no values are imputed.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Iceland national total on a single geoBoundaries ADM0 polygon.
indicators.quality_notes: Administrative National Register of Persons membership, never census affiliation, belief, or attendance. Statistics Iceland revised the population estimation method in March 2024 and updated the series from 2011 onwards.

indicators.label: Membership in published religious and life-stance organisations (%)
indicators.description: Administrative register membership in the 61 named organisation rows as a share of Total.
indicators.method: 100 times the named-organisation sum divided by the published Total.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Iceland national total on a single geoBoundaries ADM0 polygon.
indicators.quality_notes: Administrative National Register of Persons membership, never census affiliation, belief, or attendance. Statistics Iceland revised the population estimation method in March 2024 and updated the series from 2011 onwards.

indicators.label: No religious organisation (count)
indicators.description: Legacy no_religion field used for Statistics Iceland's source category No religious organisation. The label is not broadened to an irreligion claim.
indicators.method: Published No religious organisation row for Division=Total.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Iceland national total on a single geoBoundaries ADM0 polygon.
indicators.quality_notes: No religious organisation is the Statistics Iceland source name. The product does not interpret the category as irreligion, belief, or attendance.

indicators.label: No religious organisation (%)
indicators.description: Statistics Iceland's No religious organisation count as a share of Total.
indicators.method: 100 times No religious organisation divided by the published Total.
indicators.spatial_coverage: Iceland national total on a single geoBoundaries ADM0 polygon.
indicators.quality_notes: No religious organisation is the Statistics Iceland source name. The product does not interpret the category as irreligion, belief, or attendance.

visual_layers.label: Register membership share
visual_layers.description: National administrative register membership in Statistics Iceland's named organisations.
visual_layers.notes: A single national polygon is intentional: the project ships small-country national series where the source publishes no subnational membership table.

visual_layers.label: No religious organisation share
visual_layers.description: National share in Statistics Iceland's No religious organisation source category.
visual_layers.notes: No religious organisation is not interpreted as irreligion or attendance.
